title: NormalizedPolicy
description: Canonical internal representation of a health insurance policy. This is the extraction target: the LLM must emit exactly this shape from raw policy text, and every downstream calculation reads from here.

confidence.description: How reliably this value was found in the source document. 'low' means the UI must ask the user to verify before trusting any number derived from it.

cap_type.description: absolute_per_day: a rupee figure. percent_of_sum_insured: cap_value is the percentage. category_entitlement: no rupee cap, entitlement is by room category (typical of government schemes). no_limit: the policy explicitly places no cap.

cap_value.description: Rupees when cap_type is absolute_per_day; a percentage when percent_of_sum_insured; null otherwise.

resolved_per_day.description: The cap expressed in rupees per day after resolving percentages against sum_insured. null means no rupee cap applies. THIS is the only field the deduction calculator should read.

not_specified.description: true when the document is silent on this cap. Silent means NO cap, which is favourable to the patient. Never represent this as 0.

eligible_category.description: Highest room category the policy entitles the patient to. Maps onto the room_tariff keys in the hospital dataset.

source_excerpt.description: Verbatim line from the policy document that this value came from. Required for any non-null cap_value: it is the audit trail that makes hallucination visible.

policy_id.description: Internal identifier assigned at upload time. Not the insurer's policy number.

scheme_type.description: Drives which UI path is shown. government_scheme (PM-JAY, ESI, Arogya Karnataka) is package-based rather than sum-insured-based and behaves differently throughout.

policy_number.description: Store masked (last 4 characters only). This is user PII and is never needed in full.

sum_insured.description: Annual maximum in rupees. null for package-based government schemes with no single ceiling.

sum_insured_type.description: floater means the limit is shared across all covered members.

percent.description: Share of the APPROVED amount the patient pays. Applied AFTER proportionate deduction, never before.

amount.description: Rupees the patient absorbs before the insurer pays anything. 0 for most retail policies.

sub_limits.description: Per-category ceilings that override the sum insured for that category. Empty array is valid and common.

category.description: Free text, but prefer a package_code from the hospital dataset where one matches (e.g. cataract_surgery_with_iol) so the two can be joined.

label.description: Human-readable detail, needed when category is 'other' or 'specific_ailments'.

insurer_key.description: MUST match a value used in the hospital dataset's empanelment block. This key is the join between a policy and the hospitals that accept it.

restricted_to_network.description: true means non-network hospitals are not covered at all, not merely reimbursed later.

applicable.description: false when the policy waives proportionate deduction (an increasingly common selling point). If false, only the room charge difference is borne by the patient.

scalable_component_percent.description: Share of the bill that scales by the room-rent ratio. 70 is a defensible demo default; state the assumption in the UI.

exempt_categories.description: Reimbursed at actuals, never scaled by the ratio.

fields_needing_review.description: Dotted paths of any field with low confidence, e.g. 'room_rent.cap_value'. Drives the verify-this banner in the UI.

is_mock_data.description: Always true for this project. Reinforces that no real policy data is handled.
